firstPlayerRule: The player with the best acting and reading voice reads the case introduction and takes the start-player token. If the group uses the recorded introduction instead, choose the starter randomly.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The token holder chooses a location first in the Visiting Phase, followed clockwise by the others. This initial choice differs from later rounds, when the last player to obtain a location takes the token.
